user.title: Yard maintenance
user.description: Tracks lawn, turf and plant work, and keeps a mow ledger.

data_description.mower_entity: Its sessions stamp the mow date and accumulate blade wear. Leave empty to log every mow by hand.
data_description.plant_slots: How many plants this yard tracks. A slot contributes nothing until it is given a name.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Yard maintenance is already set up. Its entity ids are unprefixed, so a second yard would take _2 on every one of them.

data_description.mower_entity: Its sessions stamp the mow date and accumulate blade wear.
data_description.plant_slots: Lowering this removes the highest-numbered slots' entities. Their stored values are kept, so raising it again brings them back.

log_task.name: Log a yard task
log_task.description: Record that a dated lawn or turf task just happened.

key.name: Task
key.description: Which task to stamp, for example mow, fertilizer or aeration.

when.name: When
when.description: Defaults to now. Set it to backdate a job.

log_plant_task.name: Log a plant task
log_plant_task.description: Record a prune or a treatment against one plant slot.

blade_changed.name: Record a blade change
blade_changed.description: Start the wear clock over on a new blade.

at_hours.name: Starting hours
at_hours.description: Hours already on the blade. Use this when fitting a used blade, or when seeding an estimate rather than claiming the blade is new.
